releases.name: Circuit Flow
releases.summary:
Circuit Flow is a wire-routing puzzle game set on a compact circuit board. Draw traces to connect colored signals from the board edge to their matching components - LEDs, speakers, fans, and displays all need the right current to power up.

Start simple with single-color routes, then tackle resistors that transform signal colors, splitters that break secondaries into primaries, and mixers that combine them into new ones. Plan your paths carefully - wires can't overlap, and a wrong turn means a short circuit.

releases.name: Punch Monkey Revenge
releases.summary: They took his toy. They took the wrong monkey.It was supposed to be the first day of school. A new backpack. A peanut butter sandwich. And the only thing that mattered in the world — Mr. Banana, the stuffed best friend who'd been by his side since forever.Then the bullies grabbed him.PUNCH MONKEY REVENGE is a stylish, slow-motion action adventure where one determined little primate sets out to rescue his favorite toy from the toughest kids in school. Inspired by the cinematic action of classic movies — but served up with cartoon flair, comedy chaos, and absolutely no chill.Slow down time mid-air to dodge, dive, and pull off the perfect comeback move. Chain together fast combos with punches, kicks, spins, and tumbles. Pick up everything from slingshots and banana guns to lunch trays and dodgeballs as you bounce through every classroom, hallway, and playground in search of Mr. Banana.Every move is a stunt. Every fight is a story. Every hallway leads closer to home.Punch Monkey is coming for his toy!

releases.name: Flowstone Saga
releases.summary:
In the sleepy backwaters of Ocean's End, a young adventurer and her stalwart pet Sprig stumble on an ancient power hidden beneath long-forgotten ruins. With it, Mirai can harness the power to repair, build, and... fight.

Mirai will use these new powers to help build her home of New Riverstone, face growing threats like the Scarlet Tusk Pirates and Byzankar Empire, hunt for treasure across mountains, forests, temples, and ruins, and forge new friendships with people (and animals) across the world. Perhaps, the secrets of her past will finally be revealed as well...

Master a totally unique puzzle-battle system in this 16-bit, JRPG-inspired adventure featuring an epic story, charming characters, stunning pixel art, and epic music. Follow a grand story set in the mysterious Ocean's End islands full of lost memories, ancient ruins, pirates, treasures, and frogs.
